title: Beyond semantic models: "Domain context as code" for high-accuracy text-to-SQL
description:
How Recruit Holdings, the company behind Indeed, taught its text-to-SQL agent to read a website's hidden context with dbt. From dbt Summit 2026.

Explore dbt Summit 2026 and watch more sessions: https://www.getdbt.com/dbt-summit

Junya Morita, manager on the data management group at Recruit Holdings, shows why a text-to-SQL agent with access to the right data still returned wrong answers on the Car Sensor marketplace: near-identical event names meant different things. Rather than build a general ontology, the team took an issue-driven approach, capturing hidden context as code in a YAML file that is now written and reviewed before related features ship.

In this session you'll learn:
• Why text-to-SQL fails even with the right data
• How an issue-driven approach to domain context as code works
• How a reviewed YAML file generates logging code and QA tests

Speaker: Junya Morita, data management group, Recruit Holdings

Read more: Why your AI pilot stalled at the context gap. https://www.getdbt.com/blog/why-your-ai-pilot-stalled-at-the-context-gap
